# polylane_workspace_model_training_settings (Resource)

Manages whether workspace data may be used for model training. This is an existing workspace singleton: create and update use PATCH, while destroy only stops Terraform management and does not reset the remote settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "polylane_workspace_model_training_settings" "current" {
  workspace_id = "ws_00000000000000000000000000000000"

  # Omit allow_model_training to use the workspace plan default.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the workspace whose settings are managed.

### Optional

- `allow_model_training` (Boolean) Whether workspace data may be used to improve Polylane models. Omit to use the workspace plan default.

### Read-Only

- `effective` (Boolean) Resolved setting after applying the explicit value or workspace plan default.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import polylane_workspace_model_training_settings.current ws_00000000000000000000000000000000
```
